title: Rajya Sabha Seats by State
subject: Polity
caption: Rajya Sabha seat distribution by state with total seats, allocation method, and constitutional provision.
altText: A directed graph where a central node labeled Rajya Sabha Seats points to nodes for each state showing their seat counts (Bihar 16, Uttar Pradesh 31, Andhra Pradesh 11, Rajasthan 10, Karnataka 12) and also to nodes indicating the total number of seats (245), the allocation method (Proportional Representation), and the constitutional provision (Article 80).
